name: Cheval Maléfique
source:
A story about the search for your family’s missing horse in the Camargue in 16th-century France. Will you succeed, or meet your demise in the swamps?

[From [url=https://thepinkcurator.itch.io/cheval-malefique]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
讲述16世纪法国卡马格寻找家人失踪马匹的故事。你会成功，还是在沼泽中死去？
